sources.title: LLM Firewall for AI Applications | PromptGuard
sources.snippet: You can't see it.Neither can your model.The production firewall for AI applications. Blocks prompt injection, jailbreaks and PII leaks before they reach your model. And because no detector catches everything, containment refuses what the user never authorised — in our cloud, in your VPC, or entirely off the network.

sources.title: Prompt Guard | meta-llama/PurpleLlama | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Prompt Guard is a classifier model designed to protect Large Language Models (LLMs) against prompt attacks. It specifically targets two main types of malicious inputs: jailbreaking techniques that attempt to bypass a model's safety measures, and indirect prompt injections embedded into third-party data.
